name: ai-improve
description: Audits a codebase across nine categories and writes self-contained implementation plans that another agent or a cheaper model can carry out, each with exact files, steps that end in a check, scope limits and STOP conditions. It also writes a plan from a description or from another audit's report, hands a plan to an executor in a separate git worktree and reviews the result, and keeps the plans up to date as the code changes. It never changes source code itself
